lesson.subtitle: Lesson 6 -- Better, Bigger, Closer
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Julia | Lesson 6 -- Better, Bigger, Closer

listenings.text: Right, so I chose. And it was harder than I expected. The first one paid four hundred reais more, which is a lot when you are a student, and the office is beautiful. But it is fifty minutes away and the schedule is completely fixed. The second one is remote two days a week, so I save four hours, and the team is much smaller. In the end that is what decided it. Six people instead of forty. I am going to do real work, not photocopies. The salary is worse, but I think I am going to learn more. Ask me again in three months.

Good morning. Two internship programmes are open, and students keep asking me which is better, so here are the facts. The first is three months, starts in March, and it is the most competitive one we have: twelve places, and about four hundred students apply. The second is longer, six months, starting in April, and it is less competitive, but the hours are also less flexible. Both require advanced English and both require third semester or above. Neither is better. They are different. Choose the one that fits your schedule, not the one with the bigger name.
